home.headline: I design, build, and test accessible interfaces.
home.introduction: Hi there. I’m Carl, and I’m eager to apply for Chromatic’s Senior Product Designer role. I bring more than 15 years of experience in design and front-end development. Your emphasis on designers who understand how products work and stay involved through implementation is what draws me to this opportunity.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve tailored the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to what you’re looking for in your next Senior Product Designer.
